card.name: Just before carotenoid and organochlorine names
card.fires_on: Words and word parts right before a chemical compound name is expected, mostly carotenoids such as beta-carotene, or banned organochlorines such as dieldrin. It also fires on linking words like "and", "for" and "including" in those lists.

modes.label: Inside carotenoid names
modes.description: Parts of carotenoid names such as beta, a hyphen, or "car" before "otene".

modes.label: Linking words in compound lists
modes.description: Small words such as "and", "for" or "including" just before the next named compound.

modes.label: Start of chemical abbreviation
modes.description: The first letter of a chemical abbreviation like BPA.

card.writes: It seems to push toward word starts like "anth" and "Ori" and away from "cyc" and "arom", so it nudges the next chemical name.
card.plain: It lights up when a list of carotenoids or pesticide chemicals is about to name the next compound.
